story_timeline: 故事发生于1956年夏。7月下旬伦敦：M交代任务，邦德冒充运送者彼得·弗兰克斯；星期四晚乘BOAC Monarch航班飞纽约，次日（星期五）晚与蒂芙尼·凯斯在21俱乐部晚餐；星期六（8月4日）邦德发电报，同日萨拉托加举行The Perpetuities Stakes；随后邦德飞洛杉矶转拉斯维加斯，星期四晚10时05分在Tiara赌场二十一点桌领到5000美元报酬，继而在轮盘赢走20000美元；星期五斯班格众人在幽灵村，邦德遭毒打后由蒂芙尼救出、纵火烧村，乘手摇车逃往Rhyolite，斯班格驾火车追赶坠亡；莱特驾车接应，两人经死亡谷到洛杉矶，星期日乘伊丽莎白女王号返英，5天航程中温特与基德行刺蒂芙尼未遂，被邦德击毙；抵达伦敦后邦德再飞弗里敦，在满月之夜于法属几内亚边境以博福斯炮击落杰克·斯班格的直升机，走私链就此关闭

chapters.title: THE PIPELINE OPENS
chapters.summary: 法属几内亚基西杜古以南40英里的大荆棘丛下，一名在塞法杜钻石矿做牙医的走私者杀死一只蝎子，等候直升机交货；德国飞行员（曾在加兰德麾下服役的空军飞行员）迟到半小时，收走价值10万英镑的钻石；走私者抱怨伦敦派来的情报人员西利托收紧管制，要求加价20%，飞行员警告过去12个月已有3人因背叛或偷钻而死；走私者每月从矿工口中取钻，每包得1000英镑，存伦敦保险箱，攒够20000英镑就收手
chapters.summary_en: Under a great thorn bush forty miles south of Kissidougou in French Guinea, a dentist from the Sefadu mines who smuggles diamonds waits for the monthly helicopter. The German pilot, a former Luftwaffe man who flew under Galland, is half an hour late and takes away diamonds worth £100,000. The smuggler complains that Sillitoe, the intelligence man sent from London, has tightened the mines, demands twenty per cent more, and is warned that three men on this end of the pipeline have died in the last twelve months. He is paid £1,000 a packet into a London safe deposit and means to quit once he has £20,000.

chapters.title: GEM QUALITY
chapters.summary: 7月下旬，M在办公室教邦德辨钻：以石英冒充钻石考他，再展示Fine Blue-white、Top Crystal、Cape等品级与工业钻；M说明钻石贸易每年5000万英镑、每年至少200万英镑钻石被走私，美国是最大市场；财政部与贸易委员会因一批钻石正待运美、特别支部已掌握运送者而请首相授权动用情报机构；邦德将冒充运送者潜入走私链，终点线索是美国珠宝商The House of Diamonds及其伦敦负责人鲁弗斯·B·塞耶
chapters.summary_en: In late July M teaches Bond to tell a diamond, first fooling him with a piece of quartz, then showing him grades from Fine Blue-white to Cape and industrial stones. The diamond trade is worth £50 million a year and at least £2 million worth of stones are smuggled annually, mostly to America. The Treasury and the Board of Trade have asked the Prime Minister to let the Service take the case, since a parcel is about to go to America and Special Branch already knows the courier. Bond will pose as the courier and work in on the American jewellers The House of Diamonds and its London head, Rufus B. Saye.

chapters.title: HOT ICE
chapters.summary: 邦德见参谋长比尔，得知M忌惮的对手包括SMERSH、德国密码破译者、中国鸦片集团、黑手党与美国大帮派；助理警务处长瓦兰斯介绍运送者彼得·弗兰克斯（乡间别墅窃贼，受雇运钻酬金5000美元）及其护送人凯斯小姐，明晚5时在特拉法加宫酒店350房接头；瓦兰斯建议邦德盯住付酬环节以摸向大人物；塞耶护照资料为美国人、45岁、钻石商，常去巴黎
chapters.summary_en: Bond sees the Chief of Staff, Bill, and learns what worries M: SMERSH, German code-breakers, a Chinese opium ring, the Mafia and the big American gangs. Assistant Commissioner Vallance tells him about the courier, Peter Franks, a country-house burglar hired to carry diamonds for $5,000, and his escort, Miss Case; they are to meet at 5 p.m. the next day in Room 350 of the Trafalgar Palace Hotel. Vallance advises Bond to watch the payment end of the chain to reach the big men. Saye's passport shows an American diamond merchant of 45 who often goes to Paris.

chapters.title: "WHAT GOES ON AROUND HERE?"
chapters.summary: 邦德化装成丹克沃茨警佐手下詹姆斯警佐，随其到哈顿花园The House of Diamonds见塞耶；塞耶身材魁梧、方脸黑发、穿黑西装配金矛领带夹；丹克沃茨报出失窃钻石清单，其中Yellow Premier与Cape Unions根本不存在，塞耶却一口否认经手，以此暴露他并非真钻石商
chapters.summary_en: Disguised as Sergeant James under Sergeant Dankwaerts, Bond calls on Saye at The House of Diamonds in Hatton Garden. Saye is a big, square-faced, black-haired man in a black suit with a gold spear tie-pin. Dankwaerts reads out a list of stolen stones including Yellow Premier and Cape Unions, which do not exist; Saye denies handling them out of hand, which betrays that he is no real diamond man at all.

chapters.title: "FEUILLES MORTES"
chapters.summary: 邦德到特拉法加宫酒店350房见蒂芙尼·凯斯，她正听乔治·费耶尔的Feuilles Mortes唱片；她全名蒂芙尼，27岁、旧金山出生、金发灰眼、身高5英尺6英寸；她交代邦德扮高尔夫球手，把钻石藏进邓禄普65号高尔夫球，星期四晚乘BOAC Monarch赴纽约，住Astor酒店，投宿人迈克尔·特里（即沙迪·特里），给500英镑作经费，并约定星期五晚8时在52街21俱乐部晚餐；她随后向伦敦的ABC用录音电话汇报：运送者自称詹姆斯·邦德，用真名与护照
chapters.summary_en: Bond meets Tiffany Case in Room 350 of the Trafalgar Palace Hotel, where she is playing Georges Feyer’s ‘Feuilles Mortes’. Her full name is Tiffany, she is 27, born in San Francisco, blonde and grey-eyed, five feet six. She tells Bond to pose as a golfer, hide the diamonds in Dunlop 65 golf balls, fly to New York on the BOAC Monarch on Thursday night, stay at the Astor Hotel as Michael Tree, and gives him £500 for expenses; they will dine at the 21 Club on 52nd Street on Friday at 8 p.m. Afterwards she reports by wire-recorder telephone to ABC in London that the courier calls himself James Bond and is travelling on his real name and passport.

chapters.title: IN TRANSIT
chapters.summary: 星期四傍晚邦德在里茨酒店收M的密件：塞耶真名杰克·斯班格，是塞拉菲莫·斯班格的孪生兄弟，共管斯班格帮；兄弟5年前买下The House of Diamonds，另有非法赌马电讯服务Sure Fire Wire Service与拉斯维加斯Tiara酒店；沙迪·特里管纽约的毒品与卖淫，有5次前科；M下令一旦与该帮发生危险接触立即报告撤出、移交FBI；邦德检查点25贝雷塔手枪与消音器，司机在途中把6只新高尔夫球塞进他的球包，顺利通过伦敦机场海关，登机赴纽约，机上同行者有自称W·温特的胖旅客，其名片注明血型F
chapters.summary_en: On Thursday evening Bond receives a sealed note from M at the Ritz: Saye is really Jack Spang, twin brother of Seraffimo Spang, and together they run the Spangled Mob; five years ago the brothers bought The House of Diamonds, and they also own the illegal racing wire service Sure Fire and the Tiara hotel in Las Vegas. Shady Tree runs drugs and prostitution in New York and has five convictions. M orders Bond to report and withdraw at once if he makes dangerous contact with the gang, and to hand the case to the FBI. Bond checks his .25 Beretta and silencer; a driver slips six new golf balls into his bag, he clears London Airport customs, and boards for New York, with a fat fellow passenger who calls himself W. Winter and whose card gives his blood group as F.

chapters.title: 'SHADY' TREE
chapters.summary: 邦德在爱德怀尔德机场过关，海关只问高尔夫成绩便放行；司机洛基接他到西46街The House of Diamonds纽约总部见红发驼背的沙迪·特里；特里当面切开6只高尔夫球，取出18颗10至15克拉原钻；他不直接付5000美元，而是谎称邦德赢了他500美元桥牌赌债、翻倍得1000美元，再令其到萨拉托加押一匹叫害羞微笑的马，星期二第4场The Perpetuities Stakes，赢了即得5000美元；特里电话为Wisconsin 7-3697
chapters.summary_en: Bond clears Idlewild customs — the officer only asks about his golf — and is driven by Rocky to the New York headquarters of The House of Diamonds on West 46th Street to see the red-haired, hunchbacked Shady Tree. Tree cuts open the six golf balls in front of him and takes out eighteen rough stones of ten to fifteen carats. Instead of paying the $5,000 directly, he pretends Bond has won a $500 bridge bet from him, doubled to $1,000, and tells him to back a horse called Shy Smile in the fourth race on Tuesday, the Perpetuities Stakes at Saratoga: if it wins he gets his $5,000. Tree’s telephone number is Wisconsin 7-3697.

chapters.title: THE EYE THAT NEVER SLEEPS
chapters.summary: 邦德在街上被独臂的费利克斯·莱特以钢钩挟持，原来是老友重逢；莱特已离开CIA，现为平克顿侦探，负责赛马组，右臂与左腿已失；莱特告知害羞微笑是替身马，真正参赛的是快马Pickapepper（又拼作Picka-pepper），唇部纹身经植皮伪造，真正的害羞微笑已被枪杀；莱特还讲述蒂芙尼身世：母亲在旧金山开妓院，16岁时她遭帮派轮奸，此后不近男人，酗酒、救落水儿童、加入戒酒互助会、在里诺学发牌，终为塞拉菲莫在Tiara工作
chapters.summary_en: In the street Bond is held up by a one-armed man with a steel hook — his old friend Felix Leiter. Leiter has left the CIA and now works for Pinkerton’s on the racing squad, having lost his right arm and his left leg. He tells Bond that Shy Smile is a ringer: the horse that will run is the fast Pickapepper, its lip tattoo faked by a skin graft, and the real Shy Smile has been shot. He also tells Bond Tiffany’s story: her mother ran a brothel in San Francisco, she was gang-raped at sixteen and has kept away from men ever since, took to drink, rescued a drowning child, joined Alcoholics Anonymous, and learned to deal at Reno before working for Seraffimo at the Tiara.

chapters.title: BITTER CHAMPAGNE
chapters.summary: 星期五晚邦德与蒂芙尼在21俱乐部晚餐，喝按邦德要求调制的马提尼，原文写明调制方式为shaken and not stirred；蒂芙尼说明斯班格帮结构：两兄弟斯班格、伦敦的ABC（只通过录音电话发令）、塞拉菲莫管赌博与Tiara、沙迪管妓院与毒品；她称从未见过ABC，也从不用同一运送者两次；她将乘20世纪号列车去芝加哥再转Superchief去洛杉矶、赴拉斯维加斯；晚餐后她在Astor酒店门口吻别邦德，叮嘱他保重
chapters.summary_en: On Friday night Bond dines with Tiffany at the 21 Club and drinks Martinis made as he stipulated — the narration notes they were ‘shaken and not stirred’. Tiffany explains the Spangled Mob: the two Spang brothers, ABC in London, Seraffimo running gambling and the Tiara, Shady running brothels and drugs; she has never met ABC and never uses the same courier twice. She will take the 20th Century to Chicago and then the Superchief to Los Angeles on her way to Las Vegas. After dinner she kisses Bond goodbye outside the Astor and tells him to take care of himself.

chapters.title: STUDILLAC TO SARATOGA
chapters.summary: 星期六邦德用换位密码向伦敦发报：走私链起于杰克·斯班格、终于塞拉菲莫，枢纽是沙迪·特里办公室，ABC在伦敦指挥；星期日早9时莱特开改装车Studillac（Studebaker车身配Cadillac发动机，代托纳实测127英里时速）接邦德北上萨拉托加，途中读吉米·坎农评萨拉托加黑帮史的剪报；两人住Sagamore汽车旅馆
chapters.summary_en: On Saturday Bond cables London in transposition cipher: the pipeline begins near Jack Spang and ends with Seraffimo, its hub is Shady Tree’s office, and ABC directs it from London. On Sunday at 9 a.m. Leiter collects him in the Studillac — a Studebaker body with a Cadillac engine, clocked at 127 miles an hour at Daytona — and they drive north to Saratoga, reading a Jimmy Cannon cutting on the town’s gang history on the way. They stay at the Sagamore Motel.

chapters.title: SHY SMILE
chapters.summary: 清晨5时30分两人在练马场看替身马试跑4弗隆，速度极快；马主登记为皮萨罗（绰号Lame-brain，原管毒品，坐过圣昆廷监狱，现为Tiara董事）；莱特透露真正的害羞微笑数月前已被枪杀焚尸；当晚莱特以3000美元买通骑师廷加林·贝尔，令其在最后直道犯规骑行、使马获胜后被取消资格
chapters.summary_en: At 5.30 a.m. they watch the ringer gallop four furlongs at exercise — it is very fast. The horse is registered to Pissaro, nicknamed Lame-brain, a former drugs man who served time in San Quentin and is now a Tiara director. Leiter says the real Shy Smile was shot and burned months ago. That evening Leiter bribes the jockey, Tingaling Bell, with $3,000 to ride foul on the home straight so that the horse wins and is then disqualified.

chapters.title: THE PERPETUITIES
chapters.summary: 8月4日第二天赛马日，The Perpetuities Stakes奖金25000美元、途程1英里1弗隆，热门为Come Again与Pray Action，害羞微笑排第10号、赔率15比1；替身马率先冲线、领先5个马身，骑师贝尔在终点弯故意挤撞Pray Action的骑师T·拉基；裁判组看录像后判害羞微笑犯规取消资格，Pray Action递补夺冠；邦德的1000美元赌注落空，莱特要他傍晚6时到Acme泥浴场付贝尔2000美元
chapters.summary_en: On 4 August, the second day of the meeting, the Perpetuities Stakes is worth $25,000 over a mile and a furlong, with Come Again and Pray Action favourites and Shy Smile No. 10 at 15 to 1. The ringer wins by five lengths, but Bell deliberately crowds T. Lucky, the rider of Pray Action, round the final bend; after looking at the film the stewards disqualify Shy Smile and Pray Action is awarded the race. Bond’s $1,000 bet is lost, and Leiter tells him to pay Bell $2,000 at the Acme mud baths at 6 p.m.

chapters.title: ACME MUD AND SULPHUR
chapters.summary: 邦德到Acme泥硫浴场，全身涂满热泥、裹进木棺般的泥浴箱动弹不得；两名蒙面枪手闯入，逼问贝尔藏在灯座里的1000美元来历，随后把一桶滚烫热泥倒进贝尔的浴箱将其活活烫死，扬言电话已断、不得报警；邦德全程被困箱中无力救援
chapters.summary_en: Bond goes to the Acme Mud and Sulphur Baths, is coated in hot mud and sealed into a wooden cabinet like a coffin, unable to move. Two masked gunmen break in, demand to know where the $1,000 hidden in Bell’s lamp came from, then pour a bucket of scalding mud into Bell’s cabinet and scald him to death, warning that the telephone is cut and no one must call the police. Bond lies trapped in his own cabinet, helpless to save him.

chapters.title: "WE DON'T LIKE MISTAKES"
chapters.summary: 莱特认出凶手是斯班格帮头号杀手温特与基德：温特肥胖、拇指第一节有红疣、爱吮疣，人称Windy，晕车晕机；邦德致电沙迪·特里，对方称将再汇1000美元，令其去拉斯维加斯Tiara酒店，星期四晚10时05分在中央三张二十一点桌中靠近酒吧的一张连押5次最高注1000美元；莱特称FBI已介入，但无人能指认枪手，他本人将去拉斯维加斯找真正害羞微笑的埋尸处
chapters.summary_en: Leiter identifies the killers as Wint and Kidd, the Spangled Mob’s top hitmen: Wint is fat, has a red wart on the first joint of his thumb which he loves to suck, is known as Windy, and is sick in cars and aeroplanes. Bond telephones Shady Tree, who says another $1,000 will be sent and orders him to the Tiara in Las Vegas: on Thursday at 10.05 p.m., at the middle of the three centre blackjack tables, the one nearest the bar, he is to stake the $1,000 maximum five times in a row. Leiter says the FBI is in on the case but no one can identify the gunmen; he himself is going to Las Vegas to find where the real Shy Smile is buried.

chapters.title: RUE DE LA PAY
chapters.summary: 邦德飞抵洛杉矶转拉斯维加斯，机场有投币氧气吧；平克顿线人、出租司机欧内斯特·库雷奥（编号2584）以每天50美元包车接应，警告邦德在机场已被16毫米微型相机偷拍；库雷奥沿Strip介绍Flamingo酒店（巴格西·西格尔1946年建、1947年被杀）、Sands、Desert Inn、Sahara诸酒店，Strip被戏称为Rue de la Pay；邦德住进Tiara酒店Turquoise楼
chapters.summary_en: Bond flies to Los Angeles and on to Las Vegas, where the airport has a coin-operated oxygen bar. Ernest Cureo, cab No. 2584, a Pinkerton contact hired at $50 a day, meets him and warns him he was photographed at the airport with a 16 mm miniature camera. Driving down the Strip — which Cureo calls the Rue de la Pay — he points out the Flamingo, built by Bugsy Siegel in 1946, who was killed in 1947, and the Sands, the Desert Inn and the Sahara. Bond takes a room in the Turquoise Wing of the Tiara.

chapters.title: THE TIARA
chapters.summary: 邦德在Tiara午餐游泳，发现床头柜底藏有窃听录音机（线录机）；晚间考察赌场：被称作镀金捕鼠器式布局，进出必经老虎机与赌桌；二十一点、轮盘、骰宝等赌桌与持枪保安、头顶暗孔监视；他在酒吧喝伏特加马提尼，等候10时05分的约定，盘算如何逼斯班格现身
chapters.summary_en: Bond lunches and swims at the Tiara and finds a wire-recorder hidden in the base of his bedside table. In the evening he studies the casino: a gilded mousetrap of a layout in which everyone must pass the slot machines and tables to get in or out, with blackjack, roulette and craps tables, armed guards and peepholes in the ceiling. He drinks a Vodka Martini at the bar and waits for the 10.05 appointment, working out how to force Spang into the open.

chapters.title: THANKS FOR THE RIDE
chapters.summary: 蒂芙尼正是中央二十一点桌的发牌员，以Scarne式假洗牌与预设牌序让邦德连赢5把、每把1000美元，共得5000美元报酬；邦德违反勿再赌博的命令，转到轮盘连押红、黑、红赢下20000美元筹码，塞拉菲莫·斯班格在旁注视；邦德兑现后把其中15000美元装入航空信封寄给伦敦Universal Export总经理，自留5000美元，随后回房
chapters.summary_en: Tiffany is the dealer at the centre blackjack table, and with Scarne-style false shuffles and a stacked deck she lets Bond win five hands in a row at $1,000 a hand — his $5,000 fee. Against orders Bond moves to roulette and wins $20,000 on red, black, red, while Seraffimo Spang watches from the side. He cashes in, posts $15,000 of it by airmail to the Managing Director of Universal Export in London, keeps $5,000 for himself, and goes back to his room.

chapters.title: NIGHT FALLS IN THE PASSION PIT
chapters.summary: 次日邦德在理发店瞥见斯班格（紫色浴袍、修指甲时手指受伤、大发雷霆解雇女修甲师）；傍晚库雷奥驾车带邦德兜风，遭底特律紫帮的弗拉索与麦戈尼格尔前后夹击：先撞毁尾随的红色Jaguar，再与黑色雪佛兰枪战，邦德4枪击中雪佛兰致其翻车起火，库雷奥左臂中弹重伤；两人在95号公路旁的Passion Pit汽车影院躲避时，邦德被两名枪手用枪顶住带走，库雷奥被枪托击晕
chapters.summary_en: Next day Bond spots Spang in the barber’s shop — purple bathrobe, furious when the manicurist cuts his finger, and sacking her on the spot. That evening Cureo drives him out for a run and they are cut off by Frasso and McGonigle of the Detroit Purple Gang: the red Jaguar tailing them is wrecked, then Bond puts four shots into the black Chevrolet and it overturns and burns, but Cureo is badly wounded in the left arm. Hiding at the Passion Pit drive-in on Route 95, Bond is taken at gunpoint and Cureo is knocked out with a gun butt.

chapters.title: SPECTREVILLE
chapters.summary: 邦德被押往95号公路边的幽灵村Spectreville：斯班格买下的旧银矿鬼镇，位于Spectre山脉旁，约1905年曾采银3年，有木人行道、Pink Garter酒吧、车站与Highland Light型老火车头及Sierra Belle号Pullman车厢；邦德在酒吧与弗拉索、麦戈尼格尔搏斗后被制服；斯班格身着缀银黑色西部装、腰佩双枪，在车厢会见邦德，出示伦敦密电：彼得·弗兰克斯已被警方扣留，须查明替补运送者身份并灭口；蒂芙尼也在场；斯班格命温特与基德给邦德穿足球靴毒打（Brooklyn stomping，八成力）
chapters.summary_en: Bond is driven to Spectreville, the old silver-mining ghost town on Route 95 beside the Spectre range, which Spang has bought — it was mined for about three years around 1905 and has wooden sidewalks, the Pink Garter saloon, a station, and a Highland Light locomotive with the Sierra Belle Pullman car. After a fight in the saloon Bond is overpowered. Spang, in a silver-studded black Western outfit with two long-barrelled guns at his hips, receives him in the Pullman and shows him a cable from London: Peter Franks has been held by the police, so the substitute courier must be identified and killed. Tiffany is there too. Spang orders Wint and Kidd to give Bond a ‘Brooklyn stomping’ with football boots, at eighty per cent.

chapters.title: FLAMES COMING OUT OF THE TOP
chapters.summary: 蒂芙尼在众人就寝后唤醒被打得半死的邦德，两人纵火烧毁幽灵村木屋，乘巡道手摇车沿铁路逃往Rhyolite；斯班格亲自驾驶Cannonball号老火车追赶，手摇车燃油耗尽后邦德扳动旧道岔，把火车引上通往Spectre山脉的废弃支线，同时以贝雷塔4发子弹击中斯班格；火车冲进山中爆炸，斯班格身亡；两人徒步2英里到公路，莱特驾车赶到接应
chapters.summary_en: After the others have gone to bed, Tiffany wakes the half-dead Bond — the chapter opens on his fever dream of a frogman’s suit that does not fit, Strangways having got his measurements wrong — and together they set fire to the wooden buildings of Spectreville and escape down the line on a petrol handcar towards Rhyolite. Spang pursues in person driving the old Cannonball train; when the handcar runs out of fuel Bond throws the old points, switching the train onto a disused spur, and fires four shots at Spang. The train runs into the Spectre Mountains and explodes, killing Spang. Bond and Tiffany walk two miles to the road, where Leiter arrives by car to pick them up.

chapters.title: "NOTHING PROPINKS LIKE PROPINQUITY"
chapters.summary: 莱特讲述经过：库雷奥住院，其妻惊慌，莱特夜骑赶来见幽灵村火光而入内接应；三人经比蒂、死亡谷到洛杉矶，在贝弗利山酒店休整；平克顿为两人订下因码头罢工延期的伊丽莎白女王号船票，次日晚8时开船，华盛顿方面为蒂芙尼办了护照；莱特回拉斯维加斯继续找马尸；邦德与蒂芙尼乘TWA 93号航班Super-G Constellation经芝加哥飞纽约，邦德自认几近爱上蒂芙尼，但对未来犹豫
chapters.summary_en: Leiter explains: Cureo is in hospital, his wife in a panic, and Leiter rode through the night after seeing the fire over Spectreville. The three drive through Beatty and Death Valley to Los Angeles and rest at the Beverly Hills Hotel. Pinkerton’s has booked them on the Queen Elizabeth, delayed by a dock strike and sailing the next night at 8 p.m., and Washington has arranged a passport for Tiffany. Leiter goes back to Las Vegas to keep looking for the horse’s body; Bond and Tiffany fly TWA Flight 93, a Super-G Constellation, via Chicago to New York. Bond admits to himself that he is almost in love with Tiffany, but hesitates about the future.

chapters.title: LOVE AND SAUCE BEARNAISE
chapters.summary: 女王号星期日早8时开船；温特以WINTER署名发电报给伦敦ABC称已定位两人、请示灭口价格，ABC回电愿付20000美元、蒂芙尼由其到伦敦后亲自处理；温特与基德化名B·基特里奇与W·温特登船，住A49舱；第三天邦德与蒂芙尼在观景廊约会，互诉身世：蒂芙尼因父亲给母亲1000美元与一只蒂芙尼粉盒后离家战死硫磺岛而得名，在里诺发牌学校专修骰宝、轮盘与二十一点，周薪200美元；蒂芙尼亲手做Béarnaise酱送到邦德舱房
chapters.summary_en: The Queen sails from New York at 8 a.m. on Sunday. Wint cables ABC in London from the ship, signed WINTER, saying the parties are located and asking what price a drastic solution would fetch; ABC replies that he will pay twenty grand and will personally handle the other subject on arrival in London. Wint and Kidd board under the names B. Kitteridge and W. Winter and take Cabin A49. On the third day Bond and Tiffany meet in the Observation Lounge and talk about their pasts: Tiffany is named for the thousand dollars and the powder case from Tiffany’s her father gave her mother because she was a girl, before he walked out and was killed at Iwo Jima; she took the full dealing course at Reno, majoring in craps, roulette and blackjack, at two hundred dollars a week. She makes Béarnaise sauce and brings it to Bond’s cabin.

chapters.title: THE JOB COMES SECOND
chapters.summary: 当晚两人参加船上拍卖彩池：温特与基德以500英镑买下低场次（Low Field）选择权，天气晴好本应选高场次，邦德起疑；蒂芙尼认出胖子在吮拇指，邦德一时未联想到温特的疣；拍卖后两人在邦德舱房成为恋人，蒂芙尼称自己从未与男人睡过
chapters.summary_en: That night Bond and Tiffany take part in the ship’s auction sweep: Wint and Kidd buy the Low Field option for £500, although the fine weather should have made them take the High Field, and Bond grows suspicious. Tiffany recognises the fat man sucking his thumb, but Bond does not yet connect it with Wint’s wart. After the auction the two become lovers in Bond’s cabin, and Tiffany tells him she has never slept with a man in her life.

chapters.title: DEATH IS SO PERMANENT
chapters.summary: 凌晨3时邦德收到参谋长密电：搜查塞耶办公室发现温特致ABC的电报与ABC下令灭口蒂芙尼（20000美元）的回电；塞耶即ABC（A-B-Saye在法语中近似ABC），塞耶闻风飞巴黎、现据报在达喀尔；邦德发现蒂芙尼舱房空无一人，推断她被掳至A49舱；他以床单结绳从M层舷窗爬下8英尺潜入A49舱，见蒂芙尼被温特挟持；他先开枪击毙基德（子弹穿入白发下额部），再击毙掷出飞刀的温特，自己肋部被刀划伤；他伪造现场为两人因纸牌争执火并，把基德尸体推出舷窗，温特尸体留在舱内，带蒂芙尼回自己舱房
chapters.summary_en: At 3 a.m. Bond decodes a Most Immediate cable from the Chief of Staff: a search of Saye’s office found Wint’s cable to ABC and ABC’s reply ordering Tiffany’s elimination for $20,000; Saye is ABC — A-B-Saye is roughly ABC in French; Saye, alerted, has flown to Paris and is now reported by Interpol to be in Dakar. Bond finds Tiffany’s cabin empty and guesses she has been taken to Cabin A49. He climbs down about eight feet on a rope of knotted sheets from his M-deck porthole and gets in through the porthole: Kidd is holding Tiffany, and Bond shoots Kidd first — the bullet entering just under the peak of his white hair — then shoots Wint as he throws a knife, which grazes Bond’s ribs. He stages the scene as a quarrel over cards, pushes Kidd’s body out of the porthole and leaves Wint’s body in the cabin, then takes Tiffany back to his own cabin.

chapters.title: THE PIPELINE CLOSES
chapters.summary: 尾声回到非洲大荆棘丛：牙医走私者最后一次等直升机，抱怨新来的牙科助手（实为情报人员）像间谍；M在博斯科姆唐电话中命邦德拦截正沿走私链回程灭口的杰克·斯班格；邦德乘堪培拉飞机到弗里敦，与驻军乘卡车埋伏，用声音定位仪监听直升机；斯班格冒充飞行员降落，当场枪杀走私者，自称ABC、宣布关闭走私链；他驾直升机升空逃跑，邦德操博福斯炮将其击落，直升机坠入荆棘丛爆炸；邦德确认斯班格兄弟皆死，走私链关闭，蒂芙尼则已在伦敦住进邦德公寓的备用客房，M不予起诉
chapters.summary_en: The book returns to the great thorn bush: the dentist smuggler waits for the last time, complaining about the new dental assistant who looks like a spy. M telephones Bond at Boscombe Down and orders him to intercept Jack Spang, who is travelling back along the pipeline killing as he goes. Bond flies by Canberra to Freetown and waits in ambush with the garrison, listening for the helicopter on a sound locator. Spang lands posing as the pilot, shoots the smuggler dead on the spot, announces ‘I am ABC. I am closing down the pipeline’, and takes off. Bond fires the Bofors gun and brings the helicopter down into the thorn bush, where it explodes. Both Spang brothers are dead, the pipeline is closed, and Tiffany is already in London, installed in the spare room of Bond’s flat, with M deciding not to prosecute her.

characters.appearance_en: Blonde hair to her neck, grey eyes that change colour from grey to dark grey-blue, lightly sunburned skin, full red lips, five feet six inches tall, a large rectangular-cut diamond ring on the third finger of her right hand.
characters.age_clues_en: 27 years old, born in San Francisco, an American citizen.
characters.personality_en: Tough, ironic, lonely and wary, inwardly longing to be treated gently; her distrust of men comes from being gang-raped at sixteen.
characters.habits_en: Loves listening to Georges Feyer’s record of ‘Feuilles Mortes’, smokes Parliament cigarettes, drinks Vodka Martinis, deals blackjack at the Tiara.
characters.background_en: Her father, angry that she was a girl, gave her mother a thousand dollars and a powder case from Tiffany’s, then walked out and was killed at Iwo Jima, and her mother named her Tiffany; her mother ran a brothel in San Francisco which a gang smashed, and Tiffany was gang-raped at sixteen and left home. She worked as a hat-check girl, a taxi-dancer, an extra and a waitress, took to drink, was helped into Alcoholics Anonymous, graduated from the dealing school at Reno (majoring in craps, roulette and blackjack), worked at the Tiara for a year or two, and also acted as a courier escort for the diamond smuggling.

characters.appearance_en: Red hair, a big round face, no neck, hunchbacked, jug ears, red lips half open; wears a yellow silk shirt, with a glass of milk on his desk.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Shrewd and finicky, speaking in a thin voice, and well versed in paying people off under a lawful cover.
characters.habits_en: Drinks milk because of a stomach ulcer, and keeps a throwing knife up his sleeve.
characters.background_en: A New York gangster in charge of brothels and drugs, with five convictions; the pipeline’s contact man in New York, running the New York office of The House of Diamonds.

characters.appearance: 肥胖、矮壮、拇指第一节有红色大疣、戴双光眼镜、爱出汗、常拿手帕擦脸
characters.personality: 虐待狂、冷酷、爱吮拇指上的疣
characters.habits: 吮拇指疣、晕车晕机（出差须另付津贴）、掷飞刀
characters.background: 斯班格帮头号杀手之一，来自底特律，与基德搭档；名片注明血型F；在BOAC航班上即与邦德同机监视

relationships.change: 形影不离的杀手组合，先后在萨拉托加杀贝尔、女王号上追杀蒂芙尼，同日被邦德击毙
温特在泥浴场当面杀贝尔、女王号上挟持蒂芙尼，终被邦德开枪击毙

characters.appearance_en: Fat and thickset, with a big red wart on the first joint of his thumb, bifocal glasses, always sweating and mopping his face with a handkerchief.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: A sadist, cold-blooded, fond of sucking the wart on his thumb.
characters.habits_en: Sucking the wart on his thumb, sick in cars and aeroplanes (he is paid extra for travelling), throwing knives.
characters.background_en: One of the Spangled Mob’s top killers, from Detroit, working as Kidd’s partner; his card gives his blood group as F; he was already watching Bond on the BOAC flight.

characters.appearance: 年轻、面容俊美、过早白发、棕眼长睫、鼻丰唇薄、嘴角常带空洞微笑、齿间叼牙签，戴防水套的Stetson帽
characters.personality: 冷静、沉默、出手快
characters.background: 斯班格帮头号杀手之一，来自底特律，与温特搭档；在BOAC航班上与温特同行

relationships.change: 与温特同为斯班格帮杀手，同日被邦德击毙
女王号A49舱被邦德先开枪击毙，尸体被推出舷窗

characters.appearance_en: Young, handsome, prematurely white-haired, brown eyes with long lashes, a heavy nose and thin lips, a hollow smile at the corners of his mouth, a toothpick between his teeth, wearing a Stetson with a waterproof cover.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Calm, silent, quick to act.
characters.habits_en: Chewing a toothpick, carrying his gun in a shoulder holster.
characters.background_en: One of the Spangled Mob’s top killers, from Detroit, working as Wint’s partner; he travelled with Wint on the BOAC flight.

characters.appearance: 深发、相貌英俊、面容带天真笑意的年轻人，与邦德长相近似
characters.personality: 原文未详
characters.background: 出身良好、受过公学教育，后走上犯罪道路；受雇运钻酬金5000美元，向卧底女友泄露任务后被警方以图逃关税罪扣留

relationships.change: 弗兰克斯被捕后邦德顶替其身份潜入走私链；斯班格得知其被捕后下令查明并灭口替补者

characters.appearance_en: Dark-haired, good-looking, a young man with an innocent smile, and a likeness to Bond.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Not described in detail in the novel.
characters.background_en: Well born and public-school educated, he turned to crime; hired to carry diamonds for $5,000, he told his undercover girlfriend about the job and was arrested by the police for attempting to evade duty.

characters.appearance: 整洁、目光平直，办公室挂有5英镑伪钞装裱画
characters.personality: 干练、与邦德相熟（月亮牌一案结识）
characters.background: 苏格兰场助理警务处长，特别支部负责人，掌握鬼魂小队线报，安排邦德顶替弗兰克斯

relationships.change: 提供情报与化装、逮捕弗兰克斯，助邦德潜入

characters.appearance_en: Neat, with a straight look; his office has a framed five-pound forgery on the wall.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Efficient, and on friendly terms with Bond (they met during the Moonraker case).
characters.background_en: Assistant Commissioner of Scotland Yard, head of Special Branch; he holds the Ghost Squad tip-off about Franks and has Bond take Franks’s place.

characters.appearance: 棕眼、美丽
characters.personality: 冷淡、干练
characters.background: M办公室外间的秘书，邦德的秘书亦在同一办公室登记文件

relationships.change: 邦德离岗前与她打招呼

characters.appearance_en: Brown eyes, beautiful.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Cool and efficient.
characters.background_en: Secretary in M’s outer office; Bond’s own secretary registers papers in the same office.

characters.appearance: 瘦削、放松，与邦德年纪相仿
characters.personality: 原文未详
characters.habits: 把熄灭的火柴向左肩后抛进废纸篓
characters.background: M的参谋长，熟知M心思；结尾由其发密电告知邦德塞耶即ABC及温特来电

relationships.change: 向邦德解释M的担忧，结尾发电报示警

characters.appearance_en: Lean and relaxed, about Bond’s age.
characters.age_clues_en: About Bond’s age.
characters.personality_en: Not described in detail in the novel.
characters.habits_en: Throwing spent matches over his left shoulder into the waste-paper basket.
characters.background_en: M’s Chief of Staff, who knows M’s mind well; at the end it is he who cables Bond that Saye is ABC and that Wint has been in touch.

characters.appearance: 矮壮、棕眼直视、戴司机帽、嘴叼牙签
characters.personality: 友好、可靠、敢与帮派作对
characters.background: 拉斯维加斯出租司机，编号2584，平克顿线人，受莱特之托照看邦德；在枪战中左臂中弹住院

relationships.change: 包车护送邦德，枪战中重伤，邦德为其复仇心切
莱特请其照看邦德，事后莱特赶去医院看他

characters.appearance_en: Short and thickset, brown eyes that look straight at you, a chauffeur’s cap, a toothpick in his mouth.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Friendly, reliable, and ready to stand up to the gang.
characters.background_en: A Las Vegas cab driver, No. 2584, and a Pinkerton contact asked by Leiter to look after Bond; he is badly wounded in the left arm in the gunfight and taken to hospital.

characters.appearance: 瘦削、尖脸、浑身排骨、体重须严格控制
characters.personality: 原文未详
characters.background: 骑师，为害羞微笑（替身马）策骑；被莱特以揭发替身马要挟、收3000美元答应犯规骑行，赛后在泥浴场被温特以热泥烫死

relationships.change: 莱特以向裁判组揭发相要挟，贝尔收钱答应犯规
温特认定其双重背叛而将其烫死

characters.appearance_en: Thin, sharp-faced, all ribs, with his weight strictly controlled.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Not described in detail in the novel.
characters.habits_en: Goes to the mud baths every day to lose weight.
characters.background_en: A jockey who rides Shy Smile (the ringer); threatened by Leiter with exposure of the ringer and paid $3,000, he agrees to ride foul, and after the race Wint scalds him to death in the mud baths.

characters.appearance: 圆膀胱状头、五官挤在中央、针尖眼、黑鼻孔、湿红小嘴、肥胖身躯，穿棕西装与巧克力色领结
characters.personality: 贪吃、迟钝
characters.background: Tiara董事，原管毒品（经墨西哥边境运毒），被FBI查获后在圣昆廷服刑，戒毒后脑子受损；登记为害羞微笑的马主

relationships.change: 为斯班格帮管赛马替身骗局

characters.appearance_en: A round, bladder-shaped head with the features squeezed into the middle, pin-point eyes, black nostrils and a wet red mouth, a fat body in a brown suit and a chocolate-coloured bow tie.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Greedy and slow-witted.
characters.habits_en: Eating large meals of soft-shell crabs and ice cream.
characters.background_en: A director of the Tiara, formerly in charge of drugs (smuggled over the Mexican border), caught by the FBI and sent to San Quentin, where the cure left his mind damaged; he is registered as the owner of Shy Smile.

characters.appearance: 宽阔硬朗、方脸、淡眼深陷、穿条纹棉布西装
characters.personality: 沉默、冷峻
characters.background: 害羞微笑的练马师，与皮萨罗同桌观赛

relationships.change: 同为替身马骗局成员

characters.appearance_en: Broad and hard, square-faced, pale eyes set deep, in a striped cotton suit.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Silent and cold.
characters.background_en: Trainer of Shy Smile, watching the race at the same table as Pissaro.

characters.appearance: 原文未详其外貌，来自底特律的年轻暴徒
characters.background: 底特律帮派分子，参与拉斯维加斯追车与押送邦德去幽灵村，在酒吧被邦德打倒

relationships.change: 追捕邦德未遂，结尾被斯班格下令换人

characters.appearance_en: His appearance is not described in the novel; a young Detroit hoodlum.
characters.age_clues_en: Young.
characters.background_en: A Detroit gangster who takes part in the Las Vegas car chase and in carrying Bond off to Spectreville, and is knocked down by Bond in the saloon.

characters.appearance: 原文未详
characters.background: 底特律紫帮分子，与弗拉索搭档追车、押送邦德，在幽灵村酒吧被邦德摔向自动钢琴

relationships.change: 追捕邦德未遂，结尾被斯班格下令换人

characters.appearance_en: Not described in the novel.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.background_en: A member of the Detroit Purple Gang who works with Frasso on the car chase and in carrying Bond off, and is thrown by Bond against the jukebox in the Spectreville saloon.

characters.background: 前军情五处人员，离职后受聘于戴比尔斯，在南非与当地安全部门合作整顿钻石矿，提交严厉报告

relationships.change: 其整顿使走私者感到压力，构成故事背景

characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.background_en: A former MI5 man who left the service and was hired by De Beers to clean up the African diamond mines, working with the local security authorities in South Africa and filing a severe report.

characters.appearance: 貌不惊人、头发稀疏、戴眼镜、面色苍白、神情和善好学
characters.personality: 沉稳、机智
characters.background: 苏格兰场特别支部警佐，陪邦德化装探访塞耶，以不存在的钻石品名试出塞耶不懂行

relationships.change: 一次联合探访

characters.appearance_en: Unremarkable, thin-haired, bespectacled, pale-faced, kindly and studious-looking.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Steady and quick-witted.
characters.background_en: A Special Branch sergeant who goes with Bond, in disguise, to call on Saye, and tests Saye with the names of diamonds that do not exist.

characters.appearance: 面色蜡黄、殷勤、衣着讲究
characters.background: 苏格兰场化装专家，10分钟内为邦德化装（白鬓角、去疤、眼角阴影），妆效仅保6小时

relationships.change: 为邦德化装

characters.appearance_en: Sallow-faced, obliging, well dressed.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.background_en: A Scotland Yard make-up expert who makes Bond up in ten minutes (white sideboards, scar removed, shading at the corners of the eyes); the make-up lasts only six hours.

characters.appearance: 手粗大、指甲咬秃、穿脏卡其短裤
characters.personality: 贪婪、胆怯
characters.habits: 借牙科检查从矿工口中取钻
characters.background: 塞法杜钻石矿的牙医，走私链非洲端源头，每月向直升机交付约10万英镑钻石，每包自得1000英镑；结尾在最后一次交货时被杰克·斯班格枪杀

relationships.change: 长期为其供钻，结尾因斯班格关闭走私链而被灭口

characters.appearance_en: Big coarse hands, bitten nails, dirty khaki shorts.
characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Greedy and timid.
characters.habits_en: Taking diamonds out of the miners’ mouths during dental examinations.
characters.background_en: Dentist at the Sefadu diamond mines and the African end of the pipeline, handing about £100,000 worth of diamonds to the helicopter every month and keeping £1,000 a packet for himself; at the end he is shot dead by Jack Spang at the last handover.

characters.personality: 傲慢、瞧不起布尔人
characters.background: 前德国空军飞行员，曾在加兰德麾下保卫帝国，每月满月夜驾直升机往返丛林运钻500英里；结尾已不再出现，由斯班格顶替其飞行

relationships.change: 每月交接一次

characters.age_clues_en: No age is given in the novel.
characters.personality_en: Arrogant, and contemptuous of the Boers.
characters.background_en: A former Luftwaffe pilot who fought under Galland in defence of the Reich, flying the helicopter to and from the jungle on full-moon nights, five hundred miles each way, to carry the diamonds; at the end he no longer appears, Spang having taken his place at the controls.

organizations.role: 邦德所属机构，M任首脑；受首相授权调查钻石走私，邦德为007特工
organizations.description_en: Bond’s own organisation, headed by M; authorised by the Prime Minister to investigate the diamond smuggling, with Bond working on it as agent 007.

organizations.role: 本部反派组织，杰克与塞拉菲莫·斯班格共管，经营钻石走私、赌博、赛马骗局、毒品与卖淫，在纽约、拉斯维加斯、迈阿密、底特律、芝加哥有分支
organizations.description_en: The gang of the book, run jointly by Jack and Seraffimo Spang, dealing in diamond smuggling, gambling, racing frauds, drugs and prostitution, with branches in New York, Las Vegas, Miami, Detroit and Chicago.

organizations.role: 斯班格兄弟5年前买下的珠宝商，伦敦（哈顿花园）、纽约（西46街）、巴黎（里沃利街）三地经营，走私钻石经此切割销售
organizations.description_en: A firm of jewellers bought by the Spang brothers five years ago, trading in London (Hatton Garden), New York (West 46th Street) and Paris (Rue de Rivoli); the smuggled diamonds are cut and sold through it.

organizations.role: 瓦兰斯任助理警务处长，掌握弗兰克斯线报并逮捕其人，安排邦德顶替
organizations.description_en: Vallance is its Assistant Commissioner; it holds the tip-off about Franks, arrests him, and has Bond take his place.

organizations.role: 伦敦钻石销售垄断机构，每年贸易5000万英镑；其负责人雅各比向M展示钻石，董事长年报称矿场每年因走私损失200万英镑以上
organizations.description_en: The London monopoly for the sale of diamonds, with a trade of £50 million a year; its head, Mr. Jacobi, shows M the stones, and its chairman’s annual report says the mines lose more than £2 million a year to smuggling.

organizations.role: 聘用前军情五处人员西利托整顿非洲钻石矿
organizations.description_en: The firm that hires the former MI5 man Sillitoe to clean up the African diamond mines.

organizations.role: 莱特的雇主，绰号The Eye that Never Sleeps；为莱特订女王号船票、接邦德行李并协助蒂芙尼办护照
organizations.description_en: Leiter’s employers, nicknamed The Eye That Never Sleeps; Pinkerton’s books the Queen Elizabeth tickets for Leiter, collects Bond’s luggage and helps arrange Tiffany’s passport.

organizations.role: 美国方面调查斯班格帮；M下令邦德遇险即移交FBI，莱特称FBI已介入赛马案但进展有限
organizations.description_en: The American authority investigating the Spangled Mob; M orders Bond to hand the case to the FBI if he is in danger, and Leiter says the FBI is already in on the racing case but has made little headway.

organizations.role: 莱特原雇主，因其伤残只提供文职，莱特离职
organizations.description_en: Leiter’s former employers; after his injuries they could offer him only desk work, so he left.

organizations.role: 斯班格兄弟拥有的非法赌马电讯服务，为内华达与加州场外投注商服务
organizations.description_en: An illegal racing wire service owned by the Spang brothers, serving off-course bookmakers in Nevada and California.

organizations.role: 与斯班格帮、克利夫兰帮并列最高级别的美国帮派；弗拉索与麦戈尼格尔出自该帮
organizations.description_en: One of the top American gangs, ranked with the Spangled Mob and the Cleveland gang; Frasso and McGonigle come from it.

locations.name_en: The great thorn bush, French Guinea
locations.role: 走私链起点，位于基西杜古以南40英里、法属几内亚与利比里亚、塞拉利昂三国交界处，牙医每月满月夜在此向直升机交钻；结尾斯班格在此被击落
locations.description_en: The starting point of the pipeline, forty miles south of Kissidougou, where French Guinea meets Liberia and Sierra Leone; the dentist hands the diamonds to the helicopter there every full moon, and Spang is shot down there at the end.

locations.name_zh: 塞拉利昂塞法杜钻石矿
locations.role: 钻石来源，属Sierra International（Afric International矿业帝国一部分），牙医在此从矿工口中取钻
locations.description_en: The source of the diamonds, belonging to Sierra International (part of the Afric International mining empire); the dentist takes the stones from the miners’ mouths here.

locations.role: M总部（摄政公园）、哈顿花园The House of Diamonds、特拉法加宫酒店、里茨酒店、萨沃伊酒店；走私链中转地，ABC藏身处
locations.description_en: M’s headquarters (Regent’s Park), The House of Diamonds in Hatton Garden, the Trafalgar Palace Hotel, the Ritz and the Savoy; the pipeline’s staging post, and ABC’s hiding place.

locations.role: 爱德怀尔德机场入关、西46街The House of Diamonds纽约总部、Astor酒店、52街21俱乐部；沙迪·特里据点
locations.description_en: Idlewild Airport, where Bond clears customs; the New York headquarters of The House of Diamonds on West 46th Street, the Astor Hotel and the 21 Club on 52nd Street; Shady Tree’s base.

locations.role: 8月赛马会举办地，The Perpetuities Stakes与替身马骗局发生处；邦德与莱特住Sagamore汽车旅馆
locations.description_en: Where the August race meeting is held, the scene of the Perpetuities Stakes and the ringer fraud; Bond and Leiter stay at the Sagamore Motel.

locations.role: Tiara酒店所在地，塞拉菲莫·斯班格总部；邦德在此领报酬、赢走20000美元、遭追车枪战
locations.description_en: The home of the Tiara hotel and Seraffimo Spang’s headquarters; here Bond collects his fee, wins $20,000 from the casino and is caught in the car chase and gunfight.

locations.role: 斯班格买下的旧银矿鬼镇，位于95号公路边、Spectre山脉旁，约1905年采银3年；邦德在此被毒打、纵火逃脱；注意：地名源于Spectre山脉，与组织SPECTRE无关
locations.description_en: An old silver-mining ghost town bought by Spang, on Route 95 beside the Spectre range, mined for about three years around 1905; Bond is beaten here, sets fire to the town and escapes. Note: the name comes from the Spectre range and has nothing to do with the organisation SPECTRE.

locations.role: 幽灵村以东约50英里的另一鬼镇，现为旅游点，有威士忌酒瓶屋；邦德与蒂芙尼乘手摇车逃往该方向
locations.description_en: Another ghost town about fifty miles east of Spectreville, now a tourist sight with a house built of whisky bottles; Bond and Tiffany flee towards it by handcar.

locations.role: 邦德与蒂芙尼返英所乘邮轮，星期日早8时自纽约开船，5天航程，温特与基德在A49舱行刺、被邦德击毙
locations.description_en: The liner Bond and Tiffany take home to England, sailing from New York at 8 a.m. on Sunday on a five-day crossing; Wint and Kidd attempt to kill Tiffany in Cabin A49 and are shot dead by Bond.

locations.role: 邦德乘堪培拉飞机抵达，与弗里敦驻军埋伏拦截斯班格直升机
locations.description_en: Bond flies in by Canberra and waits in ambush with the Freetown garrison to intercept Spang’s helicopter.

locations.role: The House of Diamonds在里沃利街有店；塞耶每月去巴黎一次；结尾塞耶闻风飞巴黎、再到达喀尔
locations.description_en: The House of Diamonds has a shop in the Rue de Rivoli; Saye goes to Paris once a month, and at the end he flees there on hearing of the search, then goes on to Dakar.

locations.role: 国际刑警报告塞耶逃往达喀尔，佐证其即ABC
locations.description_en: Interpol reports Saye as having fled to Dakar, which supports the conclusion that he is ABC.

equipment.note: 邦德配枪，骨架式握把，M在上次任务后所赠；邦德亲手把撞针锉尖、锯掉准星；配消音器与30发点25子弹，藏于公文箱暗格；女王号上装消音器击毙温特与基德，对火车射出最后4发子弹
equipment.description_en: Bond’s gun, with a skeleton grip, a gift from M after his last mission; Bond filed the firing pin to a point himself and sawed off the foresight; with a silencer and thirty rounds of .25 ammunition hidden in his attaché case, it kills Wint and Kidd aboard the Queen Elizabeth, and its last four shots are fired at the train.

equipment.note: 沙迪·特里袖中藏双刃飞刀（胶布缠柄）；温特在女王号上向邦德掷出飞刀，划伤其肋部
equipment.description_en: A double-edged throwing knife (its handle bound with tape) kept up Shady Tree’s sleeve; Wint throws a knife at Bond aboard the Queen Elizabeth and grazes his ribs.

equipment.note: 温特在泥浴场与幽灵村所用手枪
equipment.description_en: The revolver Wint uses in the mud baths and at Spectreville.

equipment.note: 邦德判断基德在泥浴场所持手枪可能为点45柯尔特
equipment.description_en: Bond judges that the gun Kidd carries in the mud baths may be a .45 Colt.

equipment.note: 结尾邦德在卡车上操作博福斯炮，以曳光弹击落斯班格的直升机
equipment.description_en: The gun Bond works from the back of a lorry at the end, bringing Spang’s helicopter down with tracer fire.

equipment.note: M教邦德辨钻所用，邦德初以石英当钻石
equipment.description_en: The jeweller’s loupe M uses to teach Bond to tell a diamond; Bond first mistakes a piece of quartz for a diamond.

equipment.note: ABC通过录音电话向蒂芙尼发令；Tiara酒店床头柜底亦藏线录机监听邦德房间
equipment.description_en: ABC gives Tiffany her orders through the wire-recorder telephone; a wire-recorder is also hidden under the bedside table in Bond’s room at the Tiara to listen in on him.

equipment.note: 结尾弗里敦驻军用其监听直升机接近，报出距离30英里、时速120、高度900英尺
equipment.description_en: Used by the Freetown garrison at the end to listen for the approaching helicopter, reporting it at thirty miles, 120 miles an hour and 900 feet.

vehicles.note: 德国飞行员每月满月夜驾机往返丛林运钻，单程500英里；结尾斯班格驾机升空被博福斯炮击落
vehicles.description_en: A helicopter flown by the German pilot to and from the jungle on full-moon nights to carry the diamonds, five hundred miles each way; at the end Spang flies it away and is shot down by the Bofors gun.

vehicles.name_zh: 英国海外航空公司Stratocruiser Monarch号
vehicles.note: 邦德与蒂芙尼乘其由伦敦经香农飞纽约爱德怀尔德机场，双层客机
vehicles.description_en: The BOAC Stratocruiser Monarch on which Bond and Tiffany fly from London via Shannon to Idlewild Airport, New York; a double-deck airliner.

vehicles.note: 伦敦接邦德去机场的黑色轿车，挂红色贸易牌照
vehicles.description_en: The black Armstrong Siddeley Sapphire that takes Bond to the airport in London, carrying red trade plates.

vehicles.note: 纽约接邦德的黑色轿车，司机为洛基
vehicles.description_en: The black Oldsmobile sedan that meets Bond in New York, driven by Rocky.

vehicles.note: 莱特的车，Studebaker车身配Cadillac发动机与特制变速箱、刹车与后桥，代托纳实测127英里时速，雷蒙·罗维设计车身
vehicles.description_en: Leiter’s car: a Studebaker body with a Cadillac engine, special gearbox, brakes and rear axle, clocked at 127 miles an hour at Daytona, with a body designed by Raymond Loewy.

vehicles.note: 库雷奥的出租车，邦德以每天50美元包租；枪战中被撞毁车尾
vehicles.description_en: Cureo’s Chevrolet cab, hired by Bond at $50 a day; its rear is smashed in the gunfight.

vehicles.note: 弗拉索与麦戈尼格尔尾随邦德的跑车，带后座行李舱，撞上出租车后水箱破裂
vehicles.description_en: The red Jaguar sports car in which Frasso and McGonigle tail Bond, with a luggage compartment behind the seats; its radiator is smashed when it hits the cab.

vehicles.note: 追捕邦德的另一辆车，被邦德4枪击中后撞树翻车起火
vehicles.description_en: The other car chasing Bond, a black Chevrolet sedan, hit by four of Bond’s shots before it hits a tree, overturns and catches fire.

vehicles.name_en: Highland Light locomotive and Sierra Belle Pullman
vehicles.name_zh: Highland Light型火车头与Sierra Belle号Pullman车厢
vehicles.note: 约1870年型老火车头，斯班格收藏于幽灵村，周末驾之往返Rhyolite；邦德扳道岔使其冲上支线坠毁
vehicles.description_en: The Highland Light locomotive of about 1870 and the Sierra Belle Pullman car kept by Spang at Spectreville, which he drives to Rhyolite at weekends; Bond throws the points and sends it crashing down a disused spur.

vehicles.note: 蒂芙尼发动、两人乘之沿铁路逃往Rhyolite，燃油耗尽后弃车
vehicles.description_en: The petrol-driven railway handcar which Tiffany starts and the two ride towards Rhyolite; it runs out of fuel and is abandoned.

vehicles.note: 邦德与蒂芙尼返英所乘邮轮
vehicles.description_en: The liner Bond and Tiffany take home to England.

vehicles.note: 邦德与蒂芙尼由洛杉矶经芝加哥飞纽约所乘飞机
vehicles.description_en: The TWA Super-G Constellation, Flight 93, on which Bond and Tiffany fly from Los Angeles via Chicago to New York.

vehicles.note: 停在幽灵村Pink Garter酒吧外的黑色银饰跑车
vehicles.description_en: The black 1920 Stutz Bearcat roadster with silver fittings parked outside the Pink Garter saloon at Spectreville.

communications.name: 录音电话（wire-recorder）
communications.note: 蒂芙尼在查令十字车站电话亭拨Welbeck号码向伦敦ABC汇报，ABC以录音指令回复；她在19时15分与20时15分两次确认
communications.description_en: Tiffany calls a Welbeck number from a telephone box at Charing Cross station to report to ABC in London, and ABC answers with recorded instructions; she confirms twice, at 7.15 p.m. and 8.15 p.m.

communications.name: 电话
communications.note: 邦德致电沙迪·特里（Wisconsin 7-3697）、M在博斯科姆唐致电邦德、莱特在贝弗利山酒店多次致电纽约平克顿办公室
communications.description_en: Bond telephones Shady Tree (Wisconsin 7-3697); M telephones Bond from Boscombe Down; Leiter telephones the New York Pinkerton office several times from the Beverly Hills Hotel.

communications.name: 电报与密码电报
communications.note: 邦德星期六用换位密码（以星期六与8月4日为密钥）向Universal Export发百组电报；温特由女王号发报给ABC请示灭口价格，ABC回电出价20000美元；参谋长发Most Immediate密电示警
communications.description_en: Bond cables Universal Export in a hundred groups of transposition cipher on Saturday, using Saturday and 4 August as the keys; Wint cables ABC from the Queen Elizabeth asking the price of killing Tiffany, and ABC replies offering $20,000; the Chief of Staff sends a Most Immediate cable to warn Bond.

communications.name: 莫尔斯灯光信号
communications.note: 直升机交接时飞行员闪A、地面回闪B与C；结尾斯班格冒充飞行员时同样闪A、走私者回B与C
communications.description_en: When the helicopter makes the handover, the pilot flashes A by torch and the man on the ground answers with B and C; at the end Spang, posing as the pilot, flashes A in the same way and the smuggler answers B and C.

communications.name: 无线电与Portishead电台
communications.note: 女王号报务员经Portishead转发温特与ABC的电报及邦德的500组密码电报
communications.description_en: The Queen Elizabeth’s radio operator relays Wint’s and ABC’s cables and Bond’s five-hundred-group cipher cable through Portishead Radio.

communications.name: 扩音器
communications.note: 结尾驻军用扩音器向斯班格喊话令其勿动
communications.description_en: At the end the garrison uses a loud-hailer to order Spang not to move.

mission.objective: 查明并捣毁每年至少200万英镑钻石由非洲经伦敦走私到美国的管道，摸清幕后主使，而非仅逮捕小运送者
mission.investigation: 邦德冒充运送者彼得·弗兰克斯，由蒂芙尼·凯斯护送、把18颗原钻藏于高尔夫球内运抵纽约；经沙迪·特里付酬环节摸到赛马骗局（害羞微笑替身马）；莱特协助揭露替身马并使贝尔犯规致马被取消资格；邦德赴拉斯维加斯Tiara酒店领报酬并赢走赌场20000美元，逼斯班格现身；被押往幽灵村后确认两兄弟即走私链两端；女王号上识破温特与基德；返伦敦后赴非洲拦截沿链回程灭口的杰克·斯班格
key_clues: The House of Diamonds近3年进货减少、售货反增
塞耶对不存在的Yellow Premier与Cape Unions一口否认，暴露其不懂钻石行
6只邓禄普65号高尔夫球内藏18颗10至15克拉原钻
沙迪·特里以桥牌赌债翻倍与赛马中奖作掩护付酬5000美元
害羞微笑实为替身马Pickapepper，唇纹经植皮伪造，真马数月前已被枪杀焚尸
温特拇指第一节的红疣与吮疣习惯，及名片血型F
温特由女王号致ABC的电报与ABC回电出价20000美元灭口蒂芙尼
搜查塞耶办公室发现上述电报，证实塞耶即ABC（A-B-Saye法语近似ABC）
mission.outcome: 塞拉菲莫·斯班格驾火车追赶邦德时坠毁身亡；温特与基德在女王号上被邦德击毙；杰克·斯班格（塞耶/ABC）在非洲枪杀牙医走私者后驾直升机逃跑，被邦德以博福斯炮击落身亡；走私链关闭；蒂芙尼随邦德去伦敦，M与瓦兰斯决定不起诉她

events.title: 非洲交货
events.cause: 塞法杜矿场钻石经牙医走私者之手，每月满月夜在法属几内亚大荆棘丛交付直升机飞行员
events.effect: 价值10万英镑的原钻启程赴欧，走私链运转；西利托整顿使走私者要求加价，埋下其结尾被灭口的伏笔
events.cause_en: Diamonds from the Sefadu mines pass through the dentist smuggler, who hands them to the helicopter pilot on the full moon each month at the great thorn bush in French Guinea.
events.effect_en: Rough diamonds worth £100,000 set out for Europe and the pipeline keeps running; Sillitoe’s crackdown makes the smuggler demand more money, foreshadowing his murder at the end.

events.title: 邦德冒充运送者
events.cause: 彼得·弗兰克斯向卧底女友泄露运钻任务被警方扣留，瓦兰斯安排邦德顶替其身份与蒂芙尼接头
events.effect: 邦德以高尔夫球藏钻潜入走私链，顺利通过伦敦与纽约海关
events.cause_en: Peter Franks told his undercover girlfriend about the diamond job and was arrested by the police, so Vallance has Bond take his place and meet Tiffany.
events.effect_en: Bond carries the diamonds hidden in golf balls into the pipeline and clears London and New York customs without trouble.

events.title: 沙迪·特里付酬
events.cause: 邦德把18颗原钻运抵纽约，沙迪·特里须以合法掩护支付5000美元酬金
events.effect: 邦德得1000美元现款并获指示去萨拉托加押害羞微笑，由此摸到赛马骗局与斯班格帮赛马线
events.cause_en: Bond has delivered the eighteen rough stones to New York, and Shady Tree must pay him his $5,000 fee under a lawful-looking cover.
events.effect_en: Bond gets $1,000 in cash and is told to back Shy Smile at Saratoga, which leads him to the racing fraud and the Spangled Mob’s racing line.

events.title: 替身马骗局被揭露
events.cause: 莱特查出参赛的害羞微笑实为快马Pickapepper，唇纹经植皮伪造，真马已被枪杀焚尸
events.effect: 莱特买通骑师贝尔犯规骑行，替身马获胜后被取消资格，斯班格帮损失50万美元预期收益并展开报复
events.cause_en: Leiter finds that the Shy Smile entered to run is really the fast horse Pickapepper, its lip tattoo faked by a skin graft, and that the real Shy Smile was shot and burned.
events.effect_en: Leiter bribes the jockey Bell to ride foul, so the ringer wins and is then disqualified; the Spangled Mob loses an expected $500,000 and sets out for revenge.

events.title: 贝尔在泥浴场被烫死
events.cause: 温特与基德认定贝尔收受贿赂、双重背叛，斯班格帮以热泥倒入其浴箱灭口
events.effect: 邦德目睹行凶却无力救援，确认温特与基德身份，此后对斯班格帮的轻视转为敬畏
events.title_en: Bell is scalded to death in the mud baths
events.cause_en: Wint and Kidd decide that Bell has taken a bribe and betrayed them twice over, and the Spangled Mob kills him by pouring hot mud into his bath cabinet.
events.effect_en: Bond watches the murder but is helpless to stop it, learns who Wint and Kidd are, and stops underrating the Spangled Mob.

events.title: Tiara赌场二十一点与轮盘
events.cause: 沙迪·特里令邦德星期四晚10时05分在Tiara中央二十一点桌连押5次最高注，蒂芙尼以预设牌序让其赢得5000美元报酬
events.effect: 邦德违令转战轮盘又赢20000美元，塞拉菲莫现身注视，次日派人追捕邦德
events.title_en: Blackjack and roulette at the Tiara
events.cause_en: Shady Tree orders Bond to stake the $1,000 maximum five times in a row at the centre blackjack table at the Tiara at 10.05 p.m. on Thursday, and Tiffany, dealing, lets him win his $5,000 fee with a stacked deck.
events.effect_en: Bond disobeys orders, moves to roulette and wins another $20,000; Seraffimo comes out to watch him, and the next day has him hunted down.

events.title: 拉斯维加斯追车枪战
events.cause: 邦德违令赌博并羞辱帮派，弗拉索与麦戈尼格尔奉命押其去见斯班格
events.effect: 邦德击毁尾随的Jaguar与雪佛兰，库雷奥左臂重伤住院，邦德在汽车影院被俘押往幽灵村
events.cause_en: Bond has disobeyed orders, won money from the gang and insulted it, so Frasso and McGonigle are sent to bring him to Spang.
events.effect_en: Bond wrecks the tailing Jaguar and the Chevrolet, Cureo is badly wounded in the left arm and taken to hospital, and Bond is seized at the drive-in cinema and carried off to Spectreville.

events.title: 幽灵村
events.cause: 伦敦密电称弗兰克斯被捕，斯班格须查明替补运送者身份并灭口，命温特与基德毒打邦德
events.effect: 邦德遭足球靴毒打（八成力），蒂芙尼当夜救他并纵火烧村，两人乘手摇车逃亡
events.cause_en: A cable from London says Franks has been arrested, so Spang must find out who the substitute courier is and have him killed, and orders Wint and Kidd to beat Bond.
events.effect_en: Bond is beaten with football boots at eighty per cent; that night Tiffany rescues him and sets fire to the town, and the two escape by handcar.

events.title: 火车追逐与斯班格之死
events.cause: 斯班格驾Cannonball号火车追赶逃亡的邦德与蒂芙尼
events.effect: 邦德扳道岔引火车上废弃支线并开4枪，火车冲进Spectre山脉爆炸，塞拉菲莫·斯班格身亡
events.title_en: The train chase and Spang’s death
events.cause_en: Spang drives the Cannonball train in pursuit of Bond and Tiffany as they flee.
events.effect_en: Bond throws the points, switching the train onto a disused spur, and fires four shots; the train runs into the Spectre Mountains and explodes, killing Seraffimo Spang.

events.title: 女王号双杀
events.cause: 温特发电报给ABC请示灭口价格，ABC出价20000美元杀蒂芙尼；温特与基德登船挟持蒂芙尼
events.effect: 邦德由舷窗爬入A49舱击毙两人，伪造为纸牌争执火并，蒂芙尼获救；参谋长密电证实塞耶即ABC
events.title_en: The double killing on the Queen Elizabeth
events.cause_en: Wint cables ABC asking the price of killing Tiffany, ABC offers $20,000, and Wint and Kidd board the ship and seize Tiffany.
events.effect_en: Bond climbs in through the porthole of Cabin A49 and shoots both men, stages the scene as a quarrel over cards, and rescues Tiffany; a cable from the Chief of Staff confirms that Saye is ABC.

events.title: 非洲收尾
events.cause: 杰克·斯班格沿走私链回程灭口，M命邦德在弗里敦拦截
events.effect: 斯班格枪杀牙医走私者后驾直升机逃跑，被邦德以博福斯炮击落，走私链彻底关闭
events.cause_en: Jack Spang is travelling back along the pipeline killing witnesses, and M orders Bond to intercept him at Freetown.
events.effect_en: Spang shoots the dentist smuggler dead, then takes off in the helicopter and is shot down by Bond with the Bofors gun; the pipeline is closed for good.

facts.fact: 塞法杜钻石矿的牙医走私者每月满月夜在法属几内亚大荆棘丛向直升机交付约10万英镑原钻，每包自得1000英镑，目标攒够20000英镑后收手
facts.quote: the £100,000 worth of diamonds his men had filched
facts.fact_en: The dentist smuggler at the Sefadu mines hands over about £100,000 worth of rough diamonds at the great thorn bush in French Guinea every full moon, keeping £1,000 a packet for himself and meaning to quit once he has saved £20,000.

facts.fact: 走私链过去12个月已有3人死亡，1人因胆怯、2人因偷钻被杀，前任走私者死于床下凝胶炸药爆炸
facts.quote: three men have died in the last twelve months
facts.fact_en: Three men on this end of the pipeline have died in the last twelve months — one for cowardice and two for stealing from the packet — and his predecessor died when gelignite exploded under his bed.

facts.fact: 运钻直升机飞行员为前德国空军飞行员，曾在加兰德麾下作战，每月驾机往返丛林500英里运钻
facts.quote: a Luftwaffe pilot who had fought under Galland
facts.fact_en: The helicopter pilot who carries the diamonds is a former Luftwaffe pilot who fought under Galland, flying a five-hundred-mile round trip over the jungle every month.

facts.fact: M以石英冒充钻石考邦德，再展示Fine Blue-white等品级，说明钻石贸易每年5000万英镑、每年至少200万英镑钻石被走私
facts.quote: At least two million pounds worth of diamonds are being smuggled
facts.fact_en: M tests Bond with a piece of quartz passed off as a diamond, then shows him grades from Fine Blue-white upwards, and explains that the diamond trade is worth £50 million a year while at least £2 million worth of diamonds are smuggled every year.

facts.fact: 财政部与贸易委员会因一批钻石正待运美、特别支部已掌握运送者，请首相授权动用秘密情报机构调查走私案
facts.quote: the PM gave them authority to use the Service
facts.fact_en: The Treasury and the Board of Trade, faced with a parcel about to go to America and a courier already known to Special Branch, have had the Prime Minister authorise the use of the Secret Service to investigate the smuggling.

facts.fact: The House of Diamonds近3年向钻石公司进货越来越少、售货却越来越多，引起财政部怀疑；其伦敦负责人为鲁弗斯·B·塞耶
facts.quote: they seem to be selling more and more jewellery every year
facts.fact_en: The House of Diamonds has bought less and less from the Diamond Corporation over the last three years while selling more and more jewellery, which aroused the Treasury’s suspicion; its London head is Rufus B. Saye.

facts.fact: 彼得·弗兰克斯为乡间别墅窃贼，受雇运钻酬金5000美元，向卧底女友泄露任务后被警方扣留，邦德顶替其身份
facts.quote: agreed to do a smuggling job to America for $5000
facts.fact_en: Peter Franks, a country-house burglar, agreed to carry diamonds to America for $5,000, told his undercover girlfriend about the job, and was arrested by the police, so Bond takes his place.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼·凯斯27岁、旧金山出生、金发灰眼、身高5英尺6英寸、美国公民，近3年往返英国十余次，常住特拉法加宫酒店
facts.quote: American citizen. 27. Born San Francisco. Blonde. Blue eyes
facts.fact_en: Tiffany Case is 27, born in San Francisco, blonde, grey-eyed, five feet six inches tall and an American citizen, and has made more than a dozen trips to Britain in the last three years, usually staying at the Trafalgar Palace Hotel.

facts.fact: 塞耶身材魁梧、方脸黑发、穿黑西装配金矛领带夹；丹克沃茨报出不存在的Yellow Premier与Cape Unions，塞耶一口否认，暴露其并非真钻石商
facts.quote: It just happens that there aren't such things, Sir
facts.fact_en: Saye is a big, square-faced, black-haired man in a black suit with a gold spear tie-pin; when Dankwaerts names the non-existent Yellow Premier and Cape Unions, Saye denies them out of hand, betraying that he is no real diamond man.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼全名Tiffany，住特拉法加宫酒店350房，爱听乔治·费耶尔的Feuilles Mortes唱片；她令邦德把钻石藏进邓禄普65号高尔夫球，星期四晚乘BOAC Monarch赴纽约
facts.quote: It stands for Tiffany
facts.fact_en: Tiffany’s full name is Tiffany; she lives in Room 350 of the Trafalgar Palace Hotel and loves Georges Feyer’s record of ‘Feuilles Mortes’. She orders Bond to hide the diamonds in Dunlop 65 golf balls and fly to New York on the BOAC Monarch on Thursday night.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼通过查令十字车站电话亭的录音电话向伦敦ABC汇报，ABC只以录音指令回复，她从未见过ABC真人
facts.quote: Case to ABC. I repeat. Case to ABC
facts.fact_en: Tiffany reports to ABC in London through the wire-recorder telephone in the Charing Cross station call-box; ABC answers only with recorded messages, and she has never met him in person.

facts.fact: M密件证实塞耶真名杰克·斯班格，是塞拉菲莫的孪生兄弟，共管斯班格帮；兄弟5年前买下The House of Diamonds，另有非法赌马电讯服务与Tiara酒店
facts.quote: Rufus B. Saye is an alias for Jack Spang
facts.fact_en: A sealed note from M confirms that Saye is really Jack Spang, twin brother of Seraffimo Spang, and that together they run the Spangled Mob; the brothers bought The House of Diamonds five years ago and also own the illegal racing wire service Sure Fire and the Tiara hotel.

facts.fact: 邦德配枪为点25贝雷塔自动手枪（骨架式握把），M在上次任务后所赠；公文箱暗格藏消音器与30发点25子弹
facts.quote: the .25 Beretta automatic with the skeleton grip
facts.fact_en: Bond’s gun is the .25 Beretta automatic with the skeleton grip, a gift from M after his last mission; his attaché case hides a silencer and thirty rounds of .25 ammunition.

facts.fact: M下令邦德一旦与斯班格帮发生危险接触立即报告撤出、案件移交FBI，邦德须以回执确认收令
facts.quote: you will report at once and be withdrawn from the case
facts.fact_en: M orders Bond to report at once and be withdrawn from the case, handing it to the FBI, if he makes dangerous contact with the Spangled Mob, and Bond must acknowledge the order.

facts.fact: W·温特在BOAC航班上与邦德同机，名片注明血型F；其真实身份为斯班格帮杀手温特，结尾在女王号上被邦德击毙
facts.quote: MY BLOOD GROUP is F
facts.fact_en: W. Winter travels on the same BOAC flight as Bond, his card giving his blood group as F; he is really the Spangled Mob killer Wint, whom Bond later kills aboard the Queen Elizabeth.

facts.fact: 沙迪·特里为红发驼背，因胃溃疡喝牛奶，袖中藏飞刀；他当面切开6只高尔夫球取出18颗10至15克拉原钻
facts.quote: Eighteen. That's the lot
facts.fact_en: Shady Tree, red-haired and hunchbacked, drinks milk for his ulcer and keeps a knife up his sleeve; he cuts open the six golf balls in front of Bond and takes out eighteen rough stones of ten to fifteen carats.

facts.fact: 特里以桥牌赌债翻倍得1000美元作掩护付酬，再令邦德星期二第4场The Perpetuities Stakes押害羞微笑，赢了即得5000美元；其电话为Wisconsin 7-3697
facts.quote: Fourth race on Tuesday. The Perpetuities Stakes
facts.fact_en: Tree pays Bond with a pretended bridge debt doubled to $1,000, then tells him to back Shy Smile in the fourth race on Tuesday, the Perpetuities Stakes, where a win would bring him his $5,000; Tree’s telephone number is Wisconsin 7-3697.

facts.fact: 莱特已离开CIA，现为平克顿侦探公司赛马组负责人，右臂与左腿已失，右臂以钢钩代之
facts.quote: With my gun hand gone they could only offer me desk work
facts.fact_en: Leiter has left the CIA and now heads Pinkerton’s racing squad, having lost his right arm and his left leg, the arm replaced by a steel hook.

facts.fact: 莱特揭露害羞微笑为替身马，真正参赛的是快马Pickapepper，唇纹经植皮伪造；真正的害羞微笑已被枪杀
facts.quote: The horse that's due to win on Tuesday won't be Shy Smile
facts.fact_en: Leiter exposes Shy Smile as a ringer: the horse that will run is the fast Pickapepper, its lip tattoo faked by a skin graft, while the real Shy Smile has been shot.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼16岁时母亲的旧金山妓院被帮派打砸，她遭轮奸，此后不近男人；后酗酒、救落水儿童、加入戒酒互助会，在里诺发牌学校毕业
facts.quote: She was only sixteen at the time
facts.fact_en: Tiffany was sixteen when her mother’s San Francisco brothel was smashed by a gang and she was gang-raped; since then she has kept away from men. She later took to drink, rescued a drowning child, joined Alcoholics Anonymous, and graduated from the dealing school at Reno.

facts.fact: 邦德在21俱乐部晚餐时喝的马提尼按其要求调制为shaken and not stirred，原文第501行写明此语；这是本部唯一一次出现该调制方式
facts.quote: The waiter brought the Martinis, shaken and not stirred
facts.fact_en: At dinner at the 21 Club Bond drinks Martinis made as he stipulated — the narration at line 501 of Chapter 9 reads ‘shaken and not stirred’ — and this is the only time that way of making a Martini appears in the book.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼说明斯班格帮结构：两兄弟斯班格、伦敦的ABC、塞拉菲莫管赌博与Tiara、沙迪管妓院与毒品；她从不用同一运送者两次
facts.quote: It's called the Spangled Mob. Two brothers called Spang
facts.fact_en: Tiffany explains the Spangled Mob: the two Spang brothers, ABC in London, Seraffimo running gambling and the Tiara, Shady running brothels and drugs; and she never uses the same courier twice.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼将乘20世纪号列车去芝加哥再转Superchief去洛杉矶、赴拉斯维加斯；她在Astor酒店门口吻别邦德
facts.quote: Taking the 20th Century to Chicago and then the Superchief
facts.fact_en: Tiffany will take the 20th Century to Chicago and then the Superchief to Los Angeles on her way to Las Vegas, and she kisses Bond goodbye outside the Astor Hotel.

facts.fact: 邦德星期六用换位密码向伦敦发报，结论为走私链起于杰克·斯班格、终于塞拉菲莫，枢纽是沙迪·特里办公室，ABC在伦敦指挥
facts.quote: the diamond pipeline began somewhere near Jack Spang
facts.fact_en: On Saturday Bond cables London in transposition cipher, concluding that the pipeline begins near Jack Spang and ends with Seraffimo, that its hub is Shady Tree’s office, and that ABC directs it from London.

facts.fact: 莱特的Studillac为Studebaker车身配Cadillac发动机，代托纳实测127英里时速，车身由雷蒙·罗维设计
facts.quote: She clocked a hundred and twenty-seven
facts.fact_en: Leiter’s Studillac is a Studebaker body fitted with a Cadillac engine, clocked at a hundred and twenty-seven miles an hour at Daytona, with a body designed by Raymond Loewy.

facts.fact: 害羞微笑登记马主为皮萨罗（绰号Lame-brain），原管毒品、坐过圣昆廷监狱，现为Tiara董事
facts.quote: One of the directors of the Tiara happens to be called that
facts.fact_en: Shy Smile is registered to Pissaro, nicknamed Lame-brain, a former drugs man who served time in San Quentin and is now a director of the Tiara.

facts.fact: 莱特以3000美元买通骑师贝尔，令其在最后直道犯规骑行、使替身马获胜后被取消资格
facts.quote: he'll play the doublecross. Foul riding in the last furlong
facts.fact_en: Leiter bribes the jockey Bell with $3,000 to ride foul on the last furlong so that the ringer wins the race and is then disqualified.

facts.fact: 8月4日The Perpetuities Stakes奖金25000美元、途程1英里1弗隆；替身马率先冲线领先5个马身，后因贝尔挤撞Pray Action骑师被取消资格，Pray Action递补夺冠
facts.quote: No10, Shy Smile, has been disqualified
facts.fact_en: The Perpetuities Stakes on 4 August is worth $25,000 over a mile and a furlong; the ringer wins by five lengths but is disqualified after Bell crowds the rider of Pray Action, and Pray Action is awarded the race.

facts.fact: 温特与基德蒙面闯入Acme泥浴场，逼问贝尔藏在灯座里的1000美元来历，随后把滚烫热泥倒进贝尔的浴箱将其烫死
facts.quote: Better dig the guy out before his eyeballs fry
facts.fact_en: Wint and Kidd, masked, break into the Acme mud baths, question Bell about the $1,000 hidden in his lamp, then pour scalding mud into his cabinet and kill him.

facts.fact: 莱特认出凶手为温特与基德：温特肥胖、拇指第一节有红疣、爱吮疣，人称Windy，晕车晕机；两人为斯班格帮头号杀手
facts.quote: Wint is a mean bastard. A real sadist
facts.fact_en: Leiter identifies the killers as Wint and Kidd: Wint is fat, has a red wart on the first joint of his thumb which he loves to suck, is known as Windy, and is sick in cars and aeroplanes; they are the Spangled Mob’s top killers.

facts.fact: 沙迪·特里令邦德去拉斯维加斯Tiara酒店，星期四晚10时05分在中央二十一点桌连押5次最高注1000美元，之后不得再赌
facts.quote: at just five after ten on Thursday evening
facts.fact_en: Shady Tree orders Bond to the Tiara in Las Vegas, to stake the $1,000 maximum five times in a row at the centre blackjack table at 10.05 p.m. on Thursday, and then to gamble no more.

facts.fact: 出租司机欧内斯特·库雷奥编号2584，平克顿线人，邦德以每天50美元包租其车；他警告邦德在机场已被16毫米微型相机偷拍
facts.quote: ERNEST CUREO. No2584
facts.fact_en: The cab driver Ernest Cureo, No. 2584, is a Pinkerton contact whom Bond hires at $50 a day; he warns Bond that he was photographed at the airport with a 16 mm miniature camera.

facts.fact: 库雷奥介绍Strip诸酒店：Flamingo为巴格西·西格尔1946年所建、1947年被杀；Strip被戏称为Rue de la Pay
facts.quote: Bugsy Siegel built that back in 1946
facts.fact_en: Cureo describes the Strip: the Flamingo was built by Bugsy Siegel in 1946 and Siegel was killed in 1947, and the Strip is jokingly called the Rue de la Pay.

facts.fact: 邦德发现Tiara酒店Turquoise楼房间床头柜底藏有线录机窃听器；赌场布局被其称为镀金捕鼠器，进出必经赌桌
facts.quote: the wire-recorder, concealed in the base of the bedside table
facts.fact_en: Bond finds a wire-recorder bug hidden in the base of the bedside table in his Turquoise Wing room at the Tiara, and calls the casino’s layout a gilded mousetrap, since everyone must pass the tables to get in or out.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼为Tiara中央二十一点桌发牌员，以假洗牌与预设牌序让邦德连赢5把、每把1000美元，共得5000美元报酬
facts.quote: She dealt him two cards and then gave two to herself
facts.fact_en: Tiffany, dealing at the centre blackjack table at the Tiara, uses false shuffles and a stacked deck to let Bond win five hands in a row at $1,000 a hand — his $5,000 fee in all.

facts.fact: 邦德违令转战轮盘连押红、黑、红赢下20000美元筹码，兑现后把其中15000美元寄给伦敦Universal Export总经理，自留5000美元
facts.quote: Three bills of five thousand and five of ones
facts.fact_en: Bond disobeys orders, moves to roulette, wins $20,000 in chips on red, black, red, cashes in, posts $15,000 of it to the Managing Director of Universal Export in London, and keeps $5,000 for himself.

facts.fact: 拉斯维加斯追车枪战中邦德4枪击中黑色雪佛兰致其翻车起火，库雷奥左臂中弹重伤；邦德在Passion Pit汽车影院被枪手带走
facts.quote: Four bullets, at twenty yards, dead on the target
facts.fact_en: In the Las Vegas car chase Bond puts four shots into the black Chevrolet, which overturns and catches fire, while Cureo is badly wounded in the left arm; Bond is then seized by gunmen at the Passion Pit drive-in cinema.

facts.fact: 库雷奥介绍幽灵村：斯班格买下的旧银矿鬼镇，约1905年采银3年，位于Spectre山脉旁；斯班格收藏Highland Light型老火车头与Pullman车厢，周末驾之往返Rhyolite
facts.quote: Spectreville it's called seeing how it's right alongside the Spectre range
facts.fact_en: Cureo describes Spectreville as an old silver-mining ghost town bought by Spang, mined for about three years around 1905 beside the Spectre range; Spang keeps a Highland Light locomotive and a Pullman car there and drives them to Rhyolite at weekends.

facts.fact: 塞拉菲莫身着缀银黑色西部装、腰佩双枪，在幽灵村Pullman车厢会见邦德，出示伦敦密电称弗兰克斯被捕、须查明并灭口替补运送者
facts.quote: Reliably informed Peter Franks held by police on unspecified charge
facts.fact_en: Seraffimo Spang, in a silver-studded black Western outfit with two guns at his hips, receives Bond in the Pullman car at Spectreville and shows him a cable from London saying Franks has been held by the police, so the substitute courier must be found and killed.

facts.fact: 邦德在幽灵村被温特与基德穿足球靴毒打，斯班格下令Brooklyn stomping、八成力
facts.quote: Brooklyn stomping. Eighty percenter. Kay?
facts.fact_en: At Spectreville Bond is beaten with football boots by Wint and Kidd on Spang’s orders — ‘Brooklyn stomping’, at eighty per cent.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼在众人就寝后唤醒被打得半死的邦德，两人纵火烧毁幽灵村木屋，乘巡道手摇车沿铁路逃往Rhyolite
facts.quote: Next stop Rhyolite
facts.fact_en: After everyone has gone to bed Tiffany wakes the half-dead Bond, and together they set fire to the wooden buildings of Spectreville and escape down the railway on a handcar towards Rhyolite.

facts.fact: 斯班格驾Cannonball号火车追赶，邦德扳动旧道岔引火车上废弃支线并开4枪，火车冲进Spectre山脉爆炸，斯班格身亡
facts.quote: Bond's gun shouted its four words
facts.fact_en: Spang pursues them driving the Cannonball train; Bond throws the old points, switching the train onto a disused spur, and fires four shots at Spang. The train runs into the Spectre Mountains and explodes, killing Spang.

facts.fact: 莱特驾Studillac在95号公路接应邦德与蒂芙尼，三人经比蒂、死亡谷到洛杉矶；平克顿为两人订下因码头罢工延期的伊丽莎白女王号船票，次日晚8时开船
facts.quote: Sails tomorrow night at eight
facts.fact_en: Leiter picks Bond and Tiffany up on Route 95 in the Studillac and drives them through Beatty and Death Valley to Los Angeles; Pinkerton’s has booked them on the Queen Elizabeth, delayed by a dock strike and sailing the next night at eight.

facts.fact: 温特以WINTER署名由女王号发电报给伦敦ABC，称已定位邦德与蒂芙尼、请示灭口价格；ABC回电愿付20000美元，蒂芙尼由其到伦敦后亲自处理
facts.quote: WILL PAY TWENTY GRAND STOP WILL PERSONALLY HANDLE OTHER SUBJECT
facts.fact_en: Wint cables ABC in London from the Queen, signed WINTER, saying Bond and Tiffany have been located and asking the price for a drastic solution; ABC replies that he will pay twenty thousand dollars and will personally handle the other subject when she reaches London.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼得名源于父亲因她是女孩给母亲1000美元与一只蒂芙尼粉盒后离家，战死硫磺岛；她在里诺发牌学校专修骰宝、轮盘与二十一点，周薪200美元
facts.quote: he gave my mother a thousand bucks and a powder case from Tiffany's
facts.fact_en: Tiffany is named for the thousand dollars and the powder case from Tiffany’s that her father gave her mother because she was a girl, before he walked out and was killed at Iwo Jima; she trained at the Reno dealing school, majoring in craps, roulette and blackjack, at two hundred dollars a week.

facts.fact: 邦德自称还不到40岁，称婚姻多为相减而非相加，愿在退休后才要孩子
facts.quote: I'm not forty yet
facts.fact_en: Bond says he is not forty yet, that most marriages subtract one person from the other rather than adding two together, and that he would only want children after he retires.

facts.fact: 蒂芙尼在女王号上与邦德成为恋人，并称自己从未与男人睡过
facts.quote: I've never what you'd call slept with a man in my life
facts.fact_en: Aboard the Queen Elizabeth, Tiffany becomes Bond’s lover and tells him she has never slept with a man in her life.

facts.fact: 参谋长密电证实塞耶即ABC：A-B-Saye在法语中近似ABC；塞耶闻风飞巴黎，现据报在达喀尔
facts.quote: WE CONSIDER HUFUS B SAYE IS ABC
facts.fact_en: A cable from the Chief of Staff confirms that Saye is ABC: A-B-Saye is roughly ABC in French; Saye, alerted, has flown to Paris and is now reported by Interpol to be in Dakar.

facts.fact: 邦德以床单结绳从M层舷窗爬下约8英尺潜入A49舱，先开枪击毙基德，再击毙掷出飞刀的温特，自己肋部被刀划伤；随后伪造现场为两人因纸牌争执火并，把基德尸体推出舷窗
facts.quote: A blue keyhole opened just beneath the peak of the white hair
facts.fact_en: Bond climbs down about eight feet on a rope of knotted sheets from his M-deck porthole into Cabin A49, shoots Kidd first, then shoots Wint as he throws a knife, which grazes Bond’s ribs; he then stages the scene as a quarrel over cards and pushes Kidd’s body out of the porthole.

facts.fact: 杰克·斯班格冒充飞行员在法属几内亚降落，当场枪杀牙医走私者，自称ABC、宣布关闭走私链；邦德以博福斯炮击落其直升机，直升机坠入荆棘丛爆炸
facts.quote: I am ABC. I am closing down the pipeline
facts.fact_en: Jack Spang lands in French Guinea posing as the pilot, shoots the dentist smuggler dead, declares ‘I am ABC. I am closing down the pipeline’, and takes off; Bond shoots his helicopter down with the Bofors gun and it crashes into the thorn bush and explodes.

facts.fact: 结尾蒂芙尼已在伦敦住进邦德公寓的spare room，M与瓦兰斯决定不起诉她；邦德称其为得力帮手与好管家
facts.quote: She's on her way to London in a Daimler Hire, Sir
facts.fact_en: At the end Tiffany is already in London, living in the spare room of Bond’s flat, and M and Vallance have decided not to prosecute her; Bond calls her a good helper and a good housekeeper.

facts.fact: 邦德结尾自认走私链已关闭、斯班格兄弟皆死，钻石将幸存并继续流转；全书末句化用蒂芙尼的话：It reads better than it lives
facts.quote: Death is forever. But so are diamonds
facts.fact_en: Bond concludes that the pipeline is closed and both Spang brothers are dead, and that the diamonds will survive and keep moving around the world; the book’s last line echoes Tiffany’s words, ‘It reads better than it lives’.

canon_vs_inference.topic: 马提尼名言shaken, not stirred是否在本部出现
canon_vs_inference.note: 出现于第9章第501行，为叙述语：The waiter brought the Martinis, shaken and not stirred, as Bond had stipulated；邦德本人未在对话中说出该句，调制方式是其事先要求
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Whether the Martini line ‘shaken, not stirred’ appears in this novel
canon_vs_inference.note_en: It appears in Chapter 9, line 501, as narration: ‘The waiter brought the Martinis, shaken and not stirred, as Bond had stipulated.’ Bond himself never says the words in dialogue; the way the drink is made is something he asked for in advance.

canon_vs_inference.note: 以组织名出现的SPECTRE在本部未出现；全文仅有地名Spectreville与地理名Spectre range、Spectre Mountains，源于鬼镇所在的山脉名，与后来的犯罪组织无关
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Whether the word SPECTRE appears in this novel
canon_vs_inference.note_en: SPECTRE as the name of an organisation does not appear in this novel; the book has only the place name Spectreville and the geographical names Spectre range and Spectre Mountains, taken from the mountains beside the ghost town, and they have nothing to do with the later criminal organisation.

canon_vs_inference.note: 第24章参谋长密电明确认定：搜查塞耶办公室发现温特致ABC的电报与ABC回电，且A-B-Saye在法语中近似ABC；第25章斯班格亲口自称I am ABC
canon_vs_inference.note_en: Chapter 24, in the Chief of Staff’s cable, states it plainly: a search of Saye’s office found Wint’s cable to ABC and ABC’s reply, and A-B-Saye is roughly ABC in French; in Chapter 25 Spang himself says ‘I am ABC’.

canon_vs_inference.topic: 温特与基德的真实姓名
canon_vs_inference.note: 原文仅以Wint与Kidd称呼两人，女王号上化名W. Winter与B. Kitteridge；本书未给出两人全名，Winter与Kitteridge为化名而非实名，不可当作真名
canon_vs_inference.note_en: The book calls them only Wint and Kidd; aboard the Queen Elizabeth they travel under the names W. Winter and B. Kitteridge. It gives no full names for either man, and Winter and Kitteridge are aliases, not real names, and must not be treated as such.

canon_vs_inference.note: 第23章邦德自称还不到40岁；具体年龄原文未给
canon_vs_inference.note_en: In Chapter 23 Bond says he is not forty yet; the book gives no exact age.

canon_vs_inference.topic: 真正的害羞微笑已被枪杀焚尸
canon_vs_inference.note: 第11章莱特告知邦德：真马数月前已被枪杀焚尸，参赛马为替身；此为莱特陈述，原文未展示杀马现场
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: The real Shy Smile was shot and burned
canon_vs_inference.note_en: In Chapter 11 Leiter tells Bond that the real horse was shot and burned months ago and the horse entered to run is a ringer; this is Leiter’s account, and the book never shows the killing of the horse.

canon_vs_inference.topic: 斯班格之死是否由邦德子弹直接造成
canon_vs_inference.note: 第20章邦德向火车驾驶室开4枪，见斯班格面部仰起，随后火车冲进山中爆炸；原文未明言子弹是否致命，死因为火车坠毁爆炸可确认，开枪命中与否为推测
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Whether Spang is killed directly by Bond’s bullets
canon_vs_inference.note_en: In Chapter 20 Bond fires four shots at the cab of the train and sees Spang’s face tilt upwards, then the train runs into the mountains and explodes; the book never says whether the bullets were fatal, so death by the train crash and explosion is certain, but whether a shot hit him is a matter of inference.

canon_vs_inference.topic: 蒂芙尼从未与男人睡过
canon_vs_inference.note: 第23章蒂芙尼亲口对邦德所言；其16岁遭轮奸的经历由莱特在第8章讲述，两处说法并存，原文未作调和说明
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Tiffany has never slept with a man
canon_vs_inference.note_en: In Chapter 23 Tiffany tells Bond so herself; her gang-rape at sixteen is told by Leiter in Chapter 8. Both accounts stand in the book, and the book offers no explanation to reconcile them.

canon_vs_inference.note: 第20章开篇邦德梦见穿蛙人服在海底、斯特兰威兹未量准尺寸，似为被毒打后昏迷中的幻觉；原文未明言梦境含义，不作定论
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: The frogman dream at the start of Chapter 20
canon_vs_inference.note_en: Chapter 20 opens with Bond dreaming that he is in a frogman’s suit under the sea, with Strangways having got his measurements wrong; it reads as a hallucination while he lies unconscious after the beating, but the book never says what the dream means, so no conclusion is drawn.

canon_vs_inference.topic: M是否知道邦德在女王号上杀人
canon_vs_inference.note: 第25章M问及女王号双杀案，邦德称报上说是两人因纸牌争执，M表示会找瓦兰斯谈；原文未明言M是否识破，邦德杀人一事仅邦德与蒂芙尼知情
canon_vs_inference.topic_en: Whether M knows Bond killed two men aboard the Queen Elizabeth
canon_vs_inference.note_en: In Chapter 25 M asks about the double killing aboard the Queen, Bond says the papers report it as a quarrel over cards, and M says he will have a word with Vallance; the book never says whether M sees through it, and only Bond and Tiffany know Bond did the killing.

synopsis_en: In the summer of 1956, a diamond pipeline is bleeding at least two million pounds a year out of the Sierra Leone mines, through French Guinea and London, to the American market. M sends James Bond to take the place of an arrested courier, Peter Franks, and carry rough diamonds to New York hidden inside golf balls, under the escort of Tiffany Case, a beautiful, hard-bitten dealer who works for the gang. The trail leads from the London jewellers The House of Diamonds to Shady Tree in New York, a rigged race at Saratoga, and the Tiara casino in Las Vegas, where Bond is paid off at the blackjack table and then wins twenty thousand dollars at roulette against orders. Captured and beaten in the ghost town of Spectreville, he escapes with Tiffany's help, kills Seraffimo Spang in a runaway-train crash, and sails home on the Queen Elizabeth, where he shoots the gang's killers, Wint and Kidd, as they move in on Tiffany. The book closes back in Africa, where Bond shoots down Jack Spang's helicopter with a Bofors gun and the pipeline is shut for good.

mission_en.objective_en: To find out how at least two million pounds’ worth of diamonds a year are being smuggled from Africa through London to America, and to break the pipeline and identify the man behind it, rather than merely arresting a small courier.
mission_en.investigation_en: Bond poses as the courier Peter Franks, is escorted by Tiffany Case, and carries eighteen rough diamonds hidden in golf balls to New York; through Shady Tree’s payment arrangements he reaches the racing fraud — the Shy Smile ringer; Leiter helps expose the ringer and gets Bell to ride foul so the horse is disqualified; Bond goes to the Tiara in Las Vegas to collect his fee and wins $20,000 from the casino, forcing Spang into the open; taken to Spectreville, he confirms that the two brothers are the two ends of the pipeline; aboard the Queen Elizabeth he sees through Wint and Kidd; back in London he flies to Africa to intercept Jack Spang as he travels back along the pipeline killing witnesses.
key_clues_en: The House of Diamonds has bought less and less over the last three years while selling more and more.
Saye denies the non-existent Yellow Premier and Cape Unions out of hand, betraying that he knows nothing of the diamond trade.
Six Dunlop 65 golf balls hide eighteen rough stones of ten to fifteen carats.
Shady Tree disguises the $5,000 fee as a doubled bridge debt and a win on a horse race.
Shy Smile is really the ringer Pickapepper, its lip tattoo faked by a skin graft, while the real horse was shot and burned months ago.
Wint’s red wart on the first joint of his thumb, his habit of sucking it, and the blood group F on his card.
Wint’s cable from the Queen Elizabeth to ABC and ABC’s reply offering $20,000 to have Tiffany killed.
The search of Saye’s office finds those cables, proving that Saye is ABC — A-B-Saye is roughly ABC in French.
mission_en.outcome_en: Seraffimo Spang is killed when the train he is driving in pursuit of Bond runs off the line and crashes; Wint and Kidd are shot dead by Bond aboard the Queen Elizabeth; Jack Spang — Saye, ABC — shoots the dentist smuggler in Africa and is then shot down in his helicopter by Bond with the Bofors gun; the pipeline is closed; Tiffany goes to London with Bond, and M and Vallance decide not to prosecute her.
